page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8a.24xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs utilizing AMD EPYC 9T24 processors running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 384.0 GB of system memory, establishing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU ratio.

This server type does not include any local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. It also lacks dedicated GPU hardware accelerators. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps, and it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g8a.24xlarge offers a high-density allocation of dedicated AMD EPYC compute resources and memory within the general-purpose hardware class. The lack of bundled local storage and GPUs reduces overhead costs for workloads that do not require physical disk access or hardware acceleration. This configuration is suitable for enterprise applications, web serving, containerized microservices, and general-purpose business workloads requiring high vCPU counts and balanced memory capacity.
